价格.consejo: Cost of a product or service.

质量.consejo: Describe how a product is made.

打折.consejo: It is used when the price is reduced.

顾客.consejo: A person who buys in a store.

店员.consejo: A person who works in a store.

推荐.consejo: To say that something is appropriate or worth it.

划算.en: cost-effective; it is taken into account
划算.consejo: It is used for a convenient purchase for its price.

优点.consejo: Positive quality of a thing or person.

缺点.consejo: Negative quality or problem of something.

原来.consejo: You can point to the previous state or express surprise.

衬衫.consejo: Wear up with neck and sleeves.

低.consejo: Describe a small height, level or price.

texto: **打折** means that the price is low during an offer. **原价** is the previous price and **半价** equals half of the original price.
**划算** states that a purchase is worth it for what it costs and for its quality.

frases.zh: 这个 新款 的 衬衫 打折 吗?
frases.es: ¿Está rebajada esta camisa de nuevo modelo?
frases.en: Is this shirt down again model?
analisis: 这个 新款 的 衬衫

frases.zh: 打折, 原价 不 低, 现在 是 半价.
frases.es: Sí, está rebajada; el precio original no era bajo y ahora cuesta la mitad.
frases.en: Yeah, it's down; the original price wasn't low and now it costs half.
analisis: the original price was not low

frases.zh: 质量 很 好, 很 多 顾客 推荐 这 个 商品.
frases.es: La calidad es muy buena; muchos clientes recomiendan este producto.
frases.en: The quality is very good; many customers recommend this product.
analisis: 顾客 推荐 这 个 商品

frases.zh: 那 我 买, 这样 比较 划算.
frases.es: Entonces lo compro; así sale más a cuenta.
frases.en: Then I buy it, so it's more on account.

frases.zh: 这 件 衣服 原来 不 便宜, 现在 打折 了.
frases.es: Esta prenda antes no era barata; ahora está rebajada.
frases.en: This garment was not cheap before; it is now reduced.

frases.zh: 这个 商品 有 一 个 优点, 质量 很 好.
frases.es: Este producto tiene una ventaja: la calidad es muy buena.
frases.en: This product has an advantage: quality is very good.
analisis: 有 一 个 优点

frases.zh: 价格 低, 买 两 个 更 省钱.
frases.es: El precio es bajo; comprar dos ahorra más dinero.
frases.en: The price is low; buy two saves more money.

frases.zh: 这 个 新款 的 缺点 是 价格 高.
frases.es: La desventaja de este modelo nuevo es que el precio es alto.
frases.en: The disadvantage of this new model is that the price is high.
analisis: the disadvantage of the new model

frases.zh: 店员 推荐 的 商品 很 划算.
frases.es: El producto que recomienda el dependiente sale muy a cuenta.
frases.en: The product recommended by the dependent is very much on account.
analisis: 店员 推荐 的 商品
the product recommended by the dependent

opciones.explicacion: The amount of the price is «half» and the amount of the price.
Disadvantage is - - - It's a big deal.

opciones.explicacion: The phrase indicates that it is at half price.

bloques.traduccion: This product has very good quality
bloques.explicacion: It describes how the product is made.

bloques.frase: 店员 推荐 的 商品 很 划算.

opciones.texto: The product recommended by the dependent is very much on account.
opciones.explicacion: It describes a good relationship between price and value.

opciones.texto: The client says the product has a disadvantage.

bloques.pregunta: What does «原来» mean in this chapter?

opciones.explicacion: It points to the previous state.

intro: In a store, we will ask for offers and compare the price with the quality.
